description:
## What changed

Two bugs people reported are fixed. Double-tap controls set to "do nothing" no longer like the video. The guard sat on a feed panel the current app never uses, and every route from a double tap to a like, four of them, is now covered. Playback quality stops putting "Could not read the playback quality model" over every video on builds whose model getter returns nothing. It leaves the quality alone and names the getter in Hook status instead. Ghost mode no longer closes the app when a story is opened.

Errors from inside Hushfeed stay off the feed unless diagnostic logging is on. The exported report now carries a feed filter table that counts every route whether or not logging is on, so an ad report can say which route delivered the ad without a second round of questions.

Remove feed ads catches TikTok's raw auction metadata and the Creator earns commission disclosure across the feed, Following, Friends, profile, search and late-insertion routes. Hide inbox stories responds without a restart. Right-column counts follow both feed layouts. Eight optional optimizer patches ported from Kveld are built in and off by default. Media downloads validate the original address and every redirect.

In settings, every switch that needs a restart says so in its summary, the About row shows the installed version, a settings page that fails to load offers Try again first, and the Feature Gate Lab says whether the search or the filter emptied the list. The feed controls, the budget label and the hold's release control share one backdrop and one radius, and the controls can be moved with a screen reader. Inbox Clear all shows its progress. A new Playback setting, off by default, shows what is left of the day's budget on the feed.

## Validation

The release passed 1,213 runtime tests and 178 patch tests. Both Android API checks passed. The bundle carries 79 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty.

All 79 patches applied with zero failures to the TikTok 46.2.3, 46.7.3 and 46.8.3 fixtures. The provenance receipt attached to this release records every verdict, the source commit and the bundle hash. Hushfeed targets the global TikTok 46.2.3 package. Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer is required.
